budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Director reported FY26 revenues totaling $48,594,145, split into property tax, net state aid, local receipts and other funds.
The levy limit, Proposition 2 1/2 increment, new growth and excluded debt were listed to arrive at the maximum allowable levy.
The FY 2026 capital program was reported at a stated figure.
Total debt service was reported with the actual figure given.
The Town Manager's proposed budget figures by department were listed, including Schools at $27,121,995.
The DPW director is asking for a snow removal figure, and the Town Manager recommended an increase to close the gap.
budget_items.quote: bill bernard is currently asking for $363,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager recommended a $110,000 increase to close the snow removal budget gap.
budget_items.quote: an increase of $110,000 to close the gap.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW director stated Chapter 90 funding will be $418,000, unchanged for twelve years.
A 27% delinquency rate was reported, approximately $400,000 of revenue, and no sewer rate increase this year.
budget_items.quote: there is a 27% delinquency rate (approximately $400,000 of revenue).

budget_items.topic: Sewer department estimated revenue and expense
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Estimated FY26 sewer revenue and expense were reported, with the gap to come from retained earnings.
The yearly cost of the sewer operation and maintenance contract was given as a little over $100,000.
budget_items.quote: jay simeone questions what the operation and maintenance contract costs yearly.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Members asked about potential problems with retained earnings used to cover the sewer shortfall; staff did not foresee an issue.
budget_items.quote: questions if there are any potential problems related to the retained earnings.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A former committee member recalled releasing reserve funds for a possible increase in recreation director hours, and the Town Manager said the revolving account change was approved.
